variant_decisions.evidence: Orthographic only: qere מִבִּנְיָמִין (one word) and ketiv מבן ימין (written as two) name the same tribe, and ASV renders both alike as 'a man of Benjamin'. The verse's only note, 'Or, wealth', is classed alternative_rendering and attaches to the English of 'a mighty man of valor', not to this lemma, so nothing in the ASV distinguishes the readings.
